title: The most painful thing God will do is destroy the version of you that doesn’t exist. ⚔️
paragraphs: The most painful thing God will do is destroy the version of you that doesn’t exist. ⚔️
We spend years building pedestals for our careers, our relationships, and our reputations, calling it "identity." But anything that can be destroyed was never your true foundation.
When God shatters those idols, it feels like death. But He isn't trying to hurt you; He is trying to reveal you. You are not what you do. You are not what you have lost. You are His.
Let the false self burn so the true warrior can rise. 🔥
📖 “I have been crucified with Christ and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me.” — Galatians 2:20
